decisions.reason: Relocating and reorienting the placard does not change the spout geometry; the message's barista-facing spout statement reaffirms the candidate's existing orientation.
The placard relocation does not change the established beige body or green accent colors.
Moving the branded placard to the customer-facing side does not alter the established DJ-turntable visual theme or decorative controls.
Placard position and viewing orientation do not change bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or enclosure-size constraints.
Relocating an existing placard does not necessarily change the enclosure's thickness, overall size, or accommodation of the mixing wells.
The placard relocation has no entailed effect on splash or mess control during mixing.
Placard placement does not change mixing quality, foam consistency, or whisk geometry.
The customer-facing placard decision does not change how the dispensing path must be removed, flushed, or cleaned.
Moving the existing placard changes its layout position but does not necessarily add, remove, or replace a BOM component.
The placard branding change does not modify the dispensing feed method, valve behavior, flow constraints, or texture-preservation rule.
Placard placement has no entailed effect on seals or isolation of liquid from electrical components.
Relocating the placard does not alter the milestone-local strategy of using off-the-shelf electronic components.
